verdict.rationale: Shortwave's own AI Snippets feature lets users define an email template once, reuse it, and share it across a team. Variable-like `{AI placeholders}` are filled in automatically by the AI. Nothing in the evidence shows snippets carrying attachments, and there is no hands-on corroboration. missing for 10: attachments in snippets, conventional user-defined variable/merge fields (as opposed to AI-filled placeholders), detail on how snippets are inserted, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can insert saved snippets or templates — with variables and attachments — instead of retyping the same reply

citations.quote: AI Snippets let you define an email template once upfront and then re-use it whenever you need it.
You just need to add instructions using `{AI placeholders}` and the AI will automatically fill them out.
AI Snippets are available both for individual use and for use across your team.
By sharing AI Snippets with your team, you can build a team-wide library of common email content to help everyone work smarter and faster.
